script:
set -eu
printf 'UTC '; date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
printf 'Effective paul source fields\n'; /usr/sbin/sshd -T -C user=paul,addr=192.168.1.246,host=192.168.1.246 | egrep '^(maxstartups|persource[^ ]*|logingracetime|usedns|loglevel) '
printf 'Recent controller auth records\n'; tail -n 500 /var/log/auth.log | grep '192.168.1.246' | tail -n 100 || true
printf 'SSH socket backlog\n'; netstat -Lan | grep '\.22 ' || true
printf 'Reverse lookup timing\n'; /usr/bin/time -p getent hosts 192.168.1.246 || true
